import json
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

p = Path('results/training/kaggle_padding_ablation.json')
pull = json.loads(p.read_text())
assert pull['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved' and 'KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR' in pull['polls'][-1]['output']
root = Path('results/kaggle/padding-ablation-v1')
text = (root/'makemarketbench-padding-ablation.log').read_text()
assert 'AssertionError' in text and 'adapter_model.safetensors' in text
q = json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_account_budget_snapshot.json').read_text())
previous = pull['quota_admission']['settled_snapshots'][-1]
debit = q['quota']['gpu_seconds_used'] - previous['quota']['gpu_seconds_used']
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose':'retain the failed padding probe before comparison'},'3764fa359b9082ea5a1e4a5e3ac3aaf6e9671636'),
          'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'download_receipt':str(p),
          'status':'failed_before_comparison','exact_error':'AssertionError at the adapter_model.safetensors SHA256 guard',
          'diagnosis':'The builder globally replaced 850 with 350, including that substring inside the frozen GRPO adapter hash. The actual adapter was not changed. SFT child had launched; main failed before entering its wait/finally block, so no pair_runtime.json or comparison was saved.',
          'expected_grpo_hash':'fe632766ed8600327330d8e46425b648dd45245e20bb8d568505ea5db3eb9f6a',
          'files_sha256':{str(f):file_sha256(f) for f in root.rglob('*') if f.is_file()},
          'account_debit_seconds':debit,'quota_snapshots':[previous,q],
          'runtime_limitation':'No complete script runtime saved. Account debit is observed in the isolated allocation interval; downloaded log event times retained separately.'}
Path('results/training/kaggle_padding_ablation_failure.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
ledger_path=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger=json.loads(ledger_path.read_text())
for s in ledger['sessions']:
 if s['kernel']==pull['metadata']['id'] and s['version']==1:
  s.update(status='failed_outputs_retrieved',hours=debit/3600,hours_basis='Official account debit during this isolated failed allocation; script runtime missing.',account_debit_seconds=debit,result_file='results/training/kaggle_padding_ablation_failure.json',observed_complete_at=pull['polls'][-1]['at'])
ledger_path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
print({'account_debit_seconds':debit,'status':record['status']})
